items.title: 川普又來了！安大略湖一夕變「美國湖」 加拿大氣炸
items.title_en: Trump Returns! Ontario Lake Overnight Becomes “America Lake”, Canada Fumes
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周四(27日)簽署行政命令，宣布將美加邊境的安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)，並稱新名稱「立即生效」。此舉正值美國與加拿大貿易談判破裂、雙方互祭關稅之際，進一步加劇兩個傳統盟友間的緊張關係。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室簽署命令前表示，「我們將把安大略湖改名為美國湖，立即生效。」白宮官員指出，行政命令要求內政部長伯格姆(Doug Burgum)及內政部更新美國地理名稱資訊系統(GNIS)，並在30天內完成聯邦資料庫及相關文件的名稱變更。
安大略湖是北美五大湖之一，橫跨美加邊境，北側為加拿大安大略省，南側則為美國紐約州。由於湖泊並非完全位於美國境內，加拿大幾乎確定不會承認川普單方面更名。
加拿大工業部長趙美蘭(Melanie Joly)本周稍早在川普首度提出改名構想後便強硬回應：「我們永遠都會叫它安大略湖。就這樣。」加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)辦公室則尚未針對川普簽署行政命令發表回應。
被問及改名是在向加拿大傳遞什麼訊息時，川普起初表示「沒有任何訊息」，隨後卻再度批評加拿大長期在貿易上占美國便宜。他說：「加拿大長期以來一直在貿易上敲我們竹槓」，並稱加拿大「想被當成一個州來對待，但他們不是一個州」。
川普第二任期以來多次以「美國第51州」形容加拿大，引發加拿大方面不滿。此次也是川普第二度針對與鄰國共享的國際水域推動更名。他去年已下令將墨西哥灣(Gulf of Mexico)更名為「美國灣」(Gulf of America)，但新名稱主要適用於美國聯邦政府文件與通訊，並未獲墨西哥等其他國家普遍承認。
川普周四甚至開玩笑表示，美國現在「有一個灣，也有一個湖」，接下來只缺一個海洋，或許可以考慮替大西洋或太平洋改名。
這項改名命令也成為美加貿易戰最新一波交鋒。兩國上周歷經三天密集談判後仍宣告破局，雙方互相指責對方導致協商失敗。美國隨後對價值數十億美元的加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，卡尼政府則宣布反制關稅，預定9月8日生效。
川普進一步揚言，自明年1月起將加拿大汽車及零組件關稅提高一倍至50%。據《彭博》此前報導，川普政府也正在討論其他貿易懲罰措施，以回應加拿大最新反制行動。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Thursday (the 27th) renaming the Canada‑U.S. border lake Ontario to “Lake America,” declaring the new name “effective immediately.” The move comes as trade talks between the United States and Canada have collapsed and both sides have imposed tariffs, further heightening tensions between the two traditional allies.

Before signing the order in the Oval Office, Trump said, “We will rename Lake Ontario to Lake America, effective immediately.” White House officials said the order requires Interior Secretary Doug Burgum and the department to update the U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) and to complete the name change in federal databases and related documents within 30 days.

Lake Ontario is one of North America’s five Great Lakes, straddling the Canada‑U.S. border, with its northern shore in Canada’s Ontario province and its southern shore in New York State. Because the lake is not wholly within U.S. territory, Canada is virtually certain not to recognize Trump’s unilateral renaming.

Canada’s Minister of Industry Melanie Joly responded early this week, after Trump first floated the renaming idea, with a firm “We will always call it Lake Ontario. That’s it.” Prime Minister Mark Carney’s office has not yet issued a response to Trump’s executive order.

When asked what message the renaming was sending to Canada, Trump initially said “there is no message,” but then again criticized Canada for taking advantage of the United States in trade. He said, “Canada has been pulling the strings on trade for a long time,” and claimed Canada “wants to be treated like a state, but it’s not a state.”

Since his second term began, Trump has repeatedly referred to Canada as a “51st state,” sparking Canadian displeasure. This is his second attempt to rename a shared international water body. Last year he ordered the Gulf of Mexico to be renamed “Gulf of America,” a name that applies only to U.S. federal documents and communications and has not been widely accepted by Mexico or other nations.
Trump even joked on Thursday that the United States now “has a gulf and a lake,” and that the only thing missing is an ocean, suggesting perhaps the Atlantic or Pacific could be renamed as well.

The renaming order also marks the latest flashpoint in the U.S.–Canada trade war. After three days of intensive negotiations last week ended in a breakdown, both sides blamed each other for the failure. The United States then imposed a 50% tariff on Canadian goods worth billions of dollars, and the Carney government announced retaliatory tariffs set to take effect on September 8.

Trump further threatened to double tariffs on Canadian automobiles and parts to 50% starting in January next year. Bloomberg previously reported that the Trump administration is also discussing additional trade‑penalty measures in response to Canada’s latest counter‑actions.

items.title: 漲價還降規？三星Galaxy S26 FE比前代更貴 處理器改採聯發科
items.title_en: Price Hike and Feature Cut? Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Costs More Than Its Predecessor, Switches to MediaTek Processor
paras: 三星電子(005930-KR)周四(27日)發表Galaxy S26 FE，鎖定希望以低於旗艦機種的價格，取得部分高階功能的消費者。不過，新機售價不僅調高，處理器、記憶體、相機及裝置端人工智慧(AI)功能也有所取捨，市場定位顯得略為尷尬。
Galaxy S26 FE售價700美元，較前一代上漲50美元。在全產業面臨記憶體晶片短缺、手機價格頻頻上調之際，三星也未能避免漲價。新機將於9月3日起透過特定電信合作夥伴販售，三星官網及其他零售通路則於9月4日開賣。
為了將價格控制在700美元並避免更大幅度的漲價，三星捨棄標準版Galaxy S26採用的高通(QCOM-US)晶片，改搭效能較弱的聯發科(2454-TW)處理器。相機成像品質不及三星較昂貴的旗艦機種，記憶體也縮減至12GB，裝置端AI功能數量同樣較少。
不過，Galaxy S26 FE在軟體方面反而領先其他S26系列機種。新機出廠即搭載以Android 17為基礎的One UI 9；Galaxy S26、S26 Plus及S26 Ultra目前仍使用One UI 8.5，較新版本仍處於用戶測試階段，尚未全面推送。
硬體方面，Galaxy S26 FE配備6.7吋螢幕及120Hz更新率，仍能提供流暢的顯示體驗。4,900mAh電池搭配45W充電器時，約30分鐘可充至69%。
儘管受記憶體限制，新機仍保留Now Brief及Now Nudge等三星代表性AI功能，可主動向使用者顯示相關資訊。由Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google提供的Circle to Search視覺搜尋功能，如今也能辨識同一張圖片中的多個物件。
三星也導入My FanCam等最新相機軟體，可在已錄製的影片中自動裁切並鎖定特定人物，持續追蹤其移動、讓主體維持在畫面中央。Horizontal Lock功能則能在手機劇烈晃動甚至旋轉時，協助影片維持水平。
Galaxy S26 FE的問題在於市場定位不上不下。Google售價499美元的Pixel 10a等平價手機，已能充分滿足日常需求；售價1,300美元的Galaxy S26 Ultra則具備更強效能與更多高階功能，包括防止旁人窺視螢幕內容的Privacy Display。Galaxy S26 FE雖比旗艦機便宜，卻也因漲價及規格取捨，面臨兩端產品夾擊。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) announced the Galaxy S26 FE on Thursday (the 27th), targeting consumers who want some high‑end features at a price lower than flagship models. However, the new device not only has a higher price, but also compromises on the processor, memory, camera and on‑device AI functions, making its market positioning somewhat awkward.

The Galaxy S26 FE is priced at $700, $50 higher than the previous generation. Amid industry‑wide memory chip shortages and frequent phone price hikes, Samsung could not avoid a price increase. The device will be sold through selected telecom partners starting September 3, with Samsung’s website and other retail channels beginning sales on September 4.

To keep the price at $700 and avoid a larger hike, Samsung dropped the Qualcomm (QCOM-US) chip used in the standard Galaxy S26 and switched to a less powerful MediaTek (2454-TW) processor. The camera image quality falls short of Samsung’s more expensive flagship phones, memory is reduced to 12 GB, and the number of on‑device AI features is also lower.

However, the Galaxy S26 FE is ahead of other S26 series models in software. It ships with One UI 9 based on Android 17, while the Galaxy S26, S26 Plus and S26 Ultra are still on One UI 8.5, with the newer version still in user testing and not yet rolled out broadly.

Hardware-wise, the Galaxy S26 FE sports a 6.7‑inch display with a 120 Hz refresh rate, still delivering a smooth visual experience. Its 4,900 mAh battery paired with a 45 W charger can reach about 69 % charge in roughly 30 minutes.

Despite the memory limitation, the device retains Samsung’s signature AI features such as Now Brief and Now Nudge, which proactively show relevant information to users. Google’s Circle to Search visual search, provided by Alphabet (GOOGL-US), can now recognize multiple objects within the same image.

Samsung also adds the latest camera software like My FanCam, which automatically crops and locks onto a specific person in recorded video, continuously tracking their movement to keep the subject centered. The Horizontal Lock feature helps keep video level even when the phone is shaken or rotated.

The problem with the Galaxy S26 FE is its ambiguous market positioning. Budget phones like Google’s Pixel 10a, priced at $499, already meet everyday needs; the $1,300 Galaxy S26 Ultra offers stronger performance and more premium features, including a Privacy Display that prevents others from seeing screen content. While the S26 FE is cheaper than the flagship, its price hike and spec compromises leave it squeezed between the two ends of the product line.

items.title: 全華爾街都在質疑她！美銀策略師仍喊標普500恐跌7.5%
items.title_en: Wall Street Is Questioning Her! BofA Strategist Still Says S&P 500 Could Drop 7.5%
paras: 在華爾街當最悲觀的策略師並不容易，美國銀行美股及量化策略主管蘇布拉曼尼安(Savita Subramanian)便深有體會。她將標普500指數年底目標維持在7,100點，是《彭博》調查逾20名策略師中最低，意味著指數將較周三收盤下跌7.5%。
蘇布拉曼尼安表示，自己因這項預測遭受的批評是多年來最多。客戶過去通常提醒她不要過度樂觀，如今卻不斷追問她何時才要上調目標。
即使摩根大通及華爾街資深策略師亞德尼(Ed Yardeni)等同業近幾周陸續調高預測，她仍堅持原有看法。調整後，《彭博》調查的年底目標平均值已升至7,901點，較周三收盤高2.9%，也比她的目標高出11%。
蘇布拉曼尼安主要擔心，企業為建設人工智慧(AI)基礎設施而提高槓桿，加上信用利差異常狹窄，可能預示信用周期即將惡化。她雖承認超大規模雲端業者及大型科技股具有吸引力，但認為整個族群正處於即將落後大盤的邊緣，投資人至多應維持中立配置，甚至減碼。
輝達(NVDA-US)預估下一會計年度營收將成長70%，周四再次點燃AI行情，也緩解市場對AI支出動能放緩的疑慮。不過，蘇布拉曼尼安表示，在轉為看多以前，她需要看到企業大規模資本支出真正開始帶來收入，尤其是AI投資的變現跡象。
她指出，目前市場對運算能力的需求極為強勁，這使本輪科技熱潮不同於1990年代末的網路泡沫。雖然企業槓桿快速升高，但如今借款公司的商業前景及資產負債表，也普遍優於當年的網路企業。
在選股方面，蘇布拉曼尼安最看好大型價值股，包括能源、金融及部分軟體公司，這些企業業務體質健康，資產負債表也相對乾淨。
今年成長型及價值型指數成分調整後，價值股的吸引力進一步提高。部分半導體股由價值型轉入成長型，軟體公司及若干超大規模雲端業者則被納入價值型。她認為，價值股是篩選優質企業、同時避免支付過高估值的直接方式。
paras_en: Being the most pessimistic strategist on Wall Street isn’t easy, and Bank of America’s U.S. equities and quantitative strategy head Savita Subramanian knows that well. She keeps her year‑end target for the S&P 500 at 7,100 points, the lowest among more than 20 strategists surveyed by Bloomberg, implying a 7.5% decline from Wednesday’s close.

Subramanian says the criticism she’s received for this forecast is the most she’s faced in years. Clients who once warned her not to be overly optimistic are now repeatedly asking when she will raise the target.

Even as peers such as JPMorgan and veteran Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni have been nudging their forecasts higher in recent weeks, she sticks to her view. After the adjustments, the Bloomberg survey’s average year‑end target has risen to 7,901 points, 2.9% above Wednesday’s close and 11% above her own target.

Subramanian’s main worry is that companies are increasing leverage to build AI infrastructure while credit spreads remain unusually tight, a possible sign that the credit cycle is about to deteriorate. She acknowledges that mega‑cloud providers and large‑cap tech stocks are attractive, but believes the whole group is on the brink of underperforming the broader market, so investors should stay neutral or even trim exposure.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) forecasts a 70% revenue jump for the next fiscal year, reigniting the AI rally on Thursday and easing concerns that AI spending momentum is slowing. Still, Subramanian says she needs to see large‑scale corporate cap‑ex actually translating into revenue – especially clear monetisation of AI investments – before turning bullish.

She notes that current demand for compute power is extremely strong, making this tech wave different from the late‑1990s internet bubble. Although corporate leverage is rising quickly, today’s borrowing companies generally have better business prospects and balance sheets than the dot‑com era firms.
In stock selection, Subramanian favours large‑cap value names, including energy, financials and certain software firms, which have healthy business fundamentals and relatively clean balance sheets.

After this year’s rebalancing of growth and value index constituents, the appeal of value stocks has risen further. Some semiconductor stocks moved from value to growth, while software companies and several mega‑cloud providers were added to value. She sees value stocks as a direct way to pick quality companies while avoiding over‑paying valuations.

items.title: 輝達財報藏警訊？貨賣愈多、收款愈慢 應收帳款暴增63%
items.title_en: NVIDIA Financial Report Hints at Red Flags? More Sales, Slower Collections, Accounts Receivable Soars 63%
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)日前再度交出優於預期並上調財測的亮眼成績單，2027會計年度第二季業績及銷售展望均超越市場預估，激勵股價周四(27日)走高。然而，財報中應收帳款暴增、供應鏈承諾擴大及自由現金流驟減等數據，也浮現值得投資人警惕的訊號。

應收帳款暴增 客戶集中度升高

今年1月至7月，輝達應收帳款淨額由385億美元攀升至631億美元，增幅約63%，代表公司已完成出貨、卻尚未收到貨款的訂單快速增加。
D.A. Davidson科技研究主管盧里亞(Gil Luria)表示，這項數據值得持續關注，因為輝達的交易規模龐大，且正為遙遠的未來作出巨額承諾。
投資銀行預估，輝達應收帳款未來幾年還會繼續膨脹。美國銀行預測，應收帳款將由2027年1月約710億美元，增至2028年的1,130億美元及2029年的1,470億美元，兩年間增幅達107%。
摩根士丹利的預測更高，估計輝達應收帳款將由2027年的786億美元，增加至2029年1月的1,710億美元，增幅達117%。
客戶集中度同樣引發疑慮。輝達在季度文件中表示，僅五名直接客戶就占應收帳款總額的70%，主要為大型雲端運算業者。相較之下，去年同期則是三名直接客戶占56%，顯示公司收款來源愈來愈集中於少數大型客戶。

承諾金額翻倍 自由現金流腰斬

在尚未收回的貨款增加之際，輝達為客戶及供應商提供的支援承諾也大幅擴張，使外界對AI產業「循環融資」的批評升溫。
花旗周四報告指出，輝達的相關承諾由第一季1,190億美元增至第二季2,790億美元，成長超過一倍，主要來自記憶體晶片零組件需求。
高盛形容這些承諾「規模可觀」。輝達管理層目前支援客戶的財務承諾總額達3,660億美元，包括2,790億美元供應與產能承諾，其中多數與記憶體有關；另有290億美元雲端服務協議、250億美元資料中心租約、250億美元股權投資及50億美元資本支出。
這還不包括輝達本月稍早與多家私募股權巨頭共同宣布的5,000億美元融資安排，市場因此更加關注公司為支撐AI基礎建設及客戶需求所承擔的資金風險。
受到資產負債表壓力影響，輝達第二季自由現金流由第一季490億美元驟降至214億美元，遠低於市場預期的約430億美元。
Truist Securities分析師史坦(William Stein)指出，輝達向投資等級客戶放寬付款條件，使應收帳款周轉天數較前一季增加15天，拖累自由現金流。Freedom Capital Markets科技研究主管米克斯(Paul Meeks)認為，這項變化可能只是暫時現象，主要與輝達積極擴大新一代Vera Rubin晶片系統部署有關，但付款期限延長仍值得密切追蹤。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) recently delivered another stellar earnings report that beat expectations and raised its financial guidance, with Q2 of fiscal 2027 and sales outlook surpassing market estimates, propelling the stock higher on Thursday (27th). However, the report also revealed a sharp rise in accounts receivable, expanded supply‑chain commitments, and a sudden drop in free cash flow—signals that investors should watch closely.

Accounts receivable surged as customer concentration increased. From January to July, NVIDIA’s net accounts receivable climbed from $38.5 billion to $63.1 billion, a 63% jump, indicating that the company has shipped goods but has not yet received payment for a growing number of orders.

Gil Luria, senior research analyst at D.A. Davidson Technology, said the data warrants ongoing attention because NVIDIA’s transaction volume is massive and it is making huge commitments for the distant future.

Investment banks predict that NVIDIA’s accounts receivable will continue to expand in the coming years. JPMorgan forecasts that accounts receivable will rise from about $71 billion in January 2027 to $113 billion in 2028 and $147 billion in 2029, a 107% increase over two years.
Morgan Stanley’s forecast is even higher, estimating accounts receivable will grow from $78.6 billion in 2027 to $171 billion in January 2029, a 117% increase.

Customer concentration also raises concerns. NVIDIA disclosed that only five direct customers accounted for 70% of accounts receivable, mainly large cloud‑computing firms. In the same period last year, three direct customers accounted for 56%, showing that payment sources are becoming increasingly concentrated among a few large clients.
Commitments doubled as uncollected receivables rose, expanding NVIDIA’s support commitments to customers and suppliers and intensifying criticism of the AI industry’s “circular financing.”
Citigroup reported on Thursday that NVIDIA’s related commitments rose from $119 billion in Q1 to $279 billion in Q2, more than doubling, largely driven by demand for memory‑chip components.

Goldman Sachs described these commitments as “substantial.” NVIDIA’s management currently supports customers with $366 billion in financial commitments, including $279 billion in supply and capacity commitments—most of which relate to memory—plus $29 billion in cloud‑service agreements, $25 billion in data‑center leases, $25 billion in equity investments, and $5 billion in capital expenditures.

This does not include NVIDIA’s earlier announcement this month of a $500 billion financing arrangement with several private‑equity giants, further heightening market focus on the capital risk NVIDIA bears to support AI infrastructure and customer demand.
Due to balance‑sheet pressure, NVIDIA’s free cash flow fell sharply from $49 billion in Q1 to $21.4 billion in Q2, far below the market’s expectation of about $43 billion.

Truist Securities analyst William Stein noted that NVIDIA’s relaxed payment terms for investment‑grade customers increased accounts‑receivable days by 15 days compared to the previous quarter, dragging down free cash flow. Paul Meeks, senior research analyst at Freedom Capital Markets, believes the change may be temporary, mainly tied to NVIDIA’s aggressive expansion of the new‑generation Vera Rubin chip system, but the extended payment terms remain worth close monitoring.

items.title: Fed不能再等了！哈瑪克直言現在就是升息時機
items.title_en: Fed Can’t Wait Any Longer! Hammack Says Now Is the Time to Raise Rates
paras: 克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)周四(27日)再次呼籲升息，直言聯準會(Fed)目前的利率政策並未對經濟形成限制，面對持續高於目標的通膨，「現在就是採取行動的時候」。
哈瑪克在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾接受CNBC訪問時表示，周三公布的數據顯示，通膨折合年率仍在3%左右。儘管近幾個月物價單月漲幅有所放緩，Fed仍有必要收緊貨幣政策，讓經濟受到一定程度的抑制，才能協助通膨回落至2%目標。
Fed偏好的7月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增3.7%，排除食品及能源價格的核心PCE年增率則為3.3%。哈瑪克警告，美國通膨已連續超過五年高於Fed目標，拖得愈久，未來壓低物價的難度就愈大，家庭與企業承受的痛苦也將更加嚴重。
哈瑪克是Fed今年的利率決策投票委員。她在7月會議與另外兩名官員反對維持利率不變，主張升息1碼。Fed當時連續第五次將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在3.5%至3.75%。
她指出，當前金融環境看不出貨幣政策具有限制性。市場仍能出現兆美元級首次公開募股(IPO)，企業發債規模也屢創新高，顯示目前利率並未明顯壓抑借貸或經濟成長。
哈瑪克最擔心的是，通膨長期超標可能讓民眾形成根深柢固的通膨心理，進而改變消費決策。她近期與賓州伊利市的勞工交流時，許多人表示，即使每天工作並擁有穩定職位，仍難以維持生計，甚至無法在周末帶孩子買一支冰淇淋。
今年物價壓力主要來自伊朗戰爭、關稅及AI相關需求。Fed通常會忽略被視為暫時性的供給衝擊，但部分官員擔憂其影響可能逐漸滲入整體經濟。市場目前預期Fed在9月及10月會議仍將按兵不動，最快可能等到12月才會升息。
paras_en: Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Beth Hammack called for another rate hike on Thursday (the 27th), stating that the Fed’s current interest‑rate policy is not restraining the economy and, faced with inflation that remains above target, “now is the time to act.”

Hammack told CNBC in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, that data released on Wednesday showed inflation running at about a 3% annualized rate. Even though monthly price gains have slowed in recent months, the Fed still needs to tighten monetary policy enough to curb the economy and help bring inflation back down to the 2% goal.

The Fed’s preferred July personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, with core PCE – which excludes food and energy – up 3.3%. Hammack warned that U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s target for more than five consecutive years; the longer it lingers, the harder it will be to push prices down, and the greater the pain for households and businesses.

Hammack is a voting member of the Fed’s rate‑setting committee this year. At the July meeting she joined two other officials in voting against keeping rates unchanged, advocating a one‑point hike. The Fed at that time kept the federal‑funds target range at 3.5%‑3.75% for the fifth consecutive meeting.

She noted that the current financial environment shows no sign that monetary policy is restrictive. The market is still able to produce trillion‑dollar IPOs, and corporate bond issuance continues to hit record highs, indicating that rates are not noticeably suppressing borrowing or economic growth.

Hammack’s biggest worry is that persistently high inflation could embed an inflationary mindset in the public, altering consumption decisions. In recent talks with workers in Erie, Pennsylvania, many said that even with a steady job and daily work, they struggle to make ends meet and can’t even afford a weekend ice‑cream treat for their kids.

This year’s price pressures stem mainly from the Iran war, tariffs and AI‑related demand. The Fed usually treats such shocks as temporary supply issues, but some officials fear their effects could gradually seep into the broader economy. Markets currently expect the Fed to hold steady at the September and October meetings, with the earliest possible hike not coming until December.

items.title: 新創大利多！產創條例三讀：股票緩課稅上限衝千萬、天使輪與創投認列年限放寬至8年
items.title_en: Start‑up Boost! Industry Innovation Act Passes Third Reading: Stock Tax Deferral Cap Raised to 10 Million, Angel and VC Recognition Period Extended to 8 Years
paras: 立法院今（27）日三讀通過產業創新條例部分條文修正案，經濟部強調本次修法聚焦兩大核心領域：協助新創事業取得長期資金挹注，以及提高員工獎酬股票緩課額度，以大幅強化企業攬才與留才動能，意即新創企業給員工的股票獎酬緩課稅上限直接翻倍，從現行500萬元提高到1000萬元，大幅降低高階人才稅負；同時天使投資與創投適用優惠的新創事業認定年限，也從5年放寬到8年，讓新創團隊能獲得更充裕的資金支持。

在資本市場與新創投資環境優化方面，修正案針對第23條之1有限合夥創投事業投資新創租稅優惠進行結構性調整。考量創投機構成立初期尚需合理的案源開發與投資評估時間，修正案將第3至第5年度投資新創事業比例調整為實收出資總額的10%、20%與30%，並新增第6年度須達40%的門檻，大幅延伸創投機構的投資期程，為新創團隊提供更充裕的資金陪伴。同時，為貼近實務運作，修正案放寬外國公司認定標準，只要外國公司於台灣境內設立直接或間接控制之子公司或分公司即可適用，大幅提升創投機構的跨境投資彈性。
針對投資端與新創定義，第23條之2天使投資人租稅優惠及第23條之1的新創事業設立年限，同步由原本的未滿5年放寬至未滿8年，兩項條文皆自公布生效日起適用。此項修法不僅拉長政府資源挹注的時間軸，也讓國內新創相關規範達成一致標準，更貼近新創企業發展成熟的真實歷程與資金需求。
至於企業界最關注的留才機制，第19條之1大幅調高員工獎酬股票緩課額度，由現行的500萬元倍增至1000萬元。此條文自116年1月1日起適用，可大幅提升企業發放股票攬才的實質吸引力，降低高階關鍵人才的稅務負擔，全面提升台灣產業在國際競才戰中的戰略優勢。
經濟部強調，本次產創條例修法不僅能活絡新創投資環境，更可助益企業留住關鍵人才。後續經濟部將會同財政部儘速完備相關子法修訂，並舉辦說明會協助產業界充分了解實務申請流程，確保政策紅利精準落地，促進產業永續轉型。
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan passed a partial amendment to the Industry Innovation Act on the 27th, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs emphasized that the revision focuses on two core areas: helping start‑ups secure long‑term funding and raising the tax‑deferred stock award limit for employees. The cap for stock awards to staff is doubled from the current NT$5 million to NT$10 million, significantly lowering the tax burden on senior talent; at the same time, the eligibility period for start‑ups to receive angel‑investor and venture‑capital tax benefits is extended from five to eight years, giving new‑venture teams more ample financial support.

In terms of capital‑market and start‑up investment environment improvements, the amendment restructures the tax incentives for limited‑partnership venture‑capital firms investing in start‑ups under Article 23‑1. Recognizing that venture firms need reasonable time for deal sourcing and evaluation, the amendment sets the investment ratios for years three to five at 10%, 20% and 30% of paid‑in capital, and adds a 40% threshold for the sixth year, greatly extending the investment horizon and providing start‑ups with longer‑term capital support. It also relaxes the definition of foreign companies: any foreign firm that establishes a directly or indirectly controlled subsidiary or branch in Taiwan now qualifies, greatly enhancing cross‑border investment flexibility for venture firms.

Regarding the investment side and the definition of a start‑up, the tax benefits for angel investors under Article 23‑2 and the start‑up establishment period under Article 23‑1 are both extended from less than five years to less than eight years, effective from the date of promulgation. This change not only lengthens the timeline for government resource allocation but also aligns domestic start‑up regulations, better reflecting the real development cycle and funding needs of growing companies.

As for the talent‑retention mechanism most watched by businesses, Article 19‑1 dramatically raises the tax‑deferred stock award ceiling from NT$5 million to NT$10 million. The provision takes effect on 1 January 2027 and is expected to markedly increase the attractiveness of stock‑based recruitment, reduce the tax burden on key senior talent, and enhance Taiwan’s strategic advantage in the global talent‑competition race.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs stressed that the revision of the Industry Innovation Act will not only invigorate the start‑up investment environment but also help companies retain critical talent. The ministry will work with the Ministry of Finance to promptly finalize related subsidiary‑law amendments, hold briefings to help industry understand the application procedures, and ensure that policy benefits are precisely implemented to promote sustainable industrial transformation.

items.title: 儲氣進度落後！歐洲天然氣庫存僅63%面臨四年來最嚴峻冬季考驗 價格恐飆破100歐元
paras: 歐洲正準備在冬季來臨前填滿儲氣庫，但目前天然氣庫存補充進度落後，市場擔心，在歐洲與亞洲爭搶貨源的情況下，天然氣價格將突破每百萬瓦時100歐元(約117美元)，這將是自四年前能源危機以來首見。
天然氣約占歐盟發電量的六分之一。歐洲天然氣基準荷蘭TTF期貨周二(25日)一度升破每百萬瓦時68歐元，創2023年初以來新高，之後漲幅略為收斂。
晨星(Morningstar)資深股票分析師Tancrede Fulop說，若冬季寒冷，加上供應持續受限，天然氣價格可能升至每百萬瓦時90至120歐元。
高盛分析師在周日發布的報告中表示，如果中東液化天然氣(LNG)出口「直到2027年才逐步恢復正常」，天然氣期貨價格將需要升破每百萬瓦時100歐元，才能抑制亞洲需求，讓歐洲有能力撐過冬季並維持儲氣水準。

歐洲庫存低於五年均值

歐洲目前最大的隱憂是，天然氣庫存正處於歷史低檔。目前正值歐洲天然氣儲庫補充季，但荷姆茲海峽航運受阻，大幅削減了卡達等主要波斯灣天然氣生產國的LNG出口。
歐洲今年夏季酷熱難耐，帶動冷氣及其他高耗能家電的用電需求。相較之下，廣泛用於歐洲供暖與烹飪的天然氣需求，通常會在夏季下降。
天候條件也導致替代能源供應減少：高溫使核電發電量下滑，歐洲多地核電廠被迫停機或降低發電量，風力發電在夏季的表現也偏弱。
根據Gas Infrastructure Europe數據，歐盟天然氣庫存目前約為63%，是歷年同期最低水準之一，也比五年均值低約18個百分點。
Energy Aspects歐洲天然氣主管Matt Drinkwater說：「歐洲目前的情況顯示，進入冬季時可能缺乏足夠的庫存緩衝來因應冬季後段的寒冷天氣，尤其是儲氣量愈低，在需求尖峰日能夠從庫存中提取的天然氣量就愈少。」
Drinkwater表示，雖然持續增強的聖嬰氣候現象，有可能讓東北亞初冬天氣較為溫和，進而降低天然氣需求，但這「同時提高了冬季後段氣溫低於正常水準的風險」。

荷姆茲海峽重開盼望

關鍵變數之一，是大量中東LNG供應能否在冬季前恢復。
Drinkwater表示，如果中東LNG出口量明顯恢復，歐洲雖然仍可能以「令人不安的低庫存」迎接冬季，但可以保留更多天然氣庫存，來因應1、2月最寒冷的用氣高峰。
不過，鑑於荷姆茲海峽周邊地緣政治局勢高度動盪，未來仍充滿變數。
若中東LNG供應無法在冬季前恢復到高水準，Drinkwater表示，歐洲將面臨天然氣價格飆升、消費者能源帳單增加，最壞情況甚至可能需要限制工業用氣。
由於未來12個月全球天然氣供應增幅有限，歐洲與亞洲爭搶LNG船貨的競爭也將持續激烈。Wood Mackenzie指出，卡達的新天然氣開發案預估要到2027年下半年才能達到滿載產能。
該機構形容，歐洲正「逼近能源危機區域」，短期內幾乎沒有其他天然氣供應替代方案。與此同時，歐盟禁止所有俄羅斯LNG進口的期限也將在2027年初到來。
晨星的Fulop表示，在算進將美國LNG運往亞洲較高的航運成本後，以目前價格來看，歐洲在吸引美國LNG現貨船貨方面仍略占優勢。
但如果其他天然氣供應持續受限，歐洲將需要大幅增加美國LNG進口量。
Fulop說：「我們預估，歐洲需要約640億立方公尺的美國LNG，相當於美國LNG總出口量約77%。」
他說：「若要吸引如此不尋常的高比例供應，歐洲必須提供明顯高於亞洲的淨回值。價格若升至區間高端，也將開始透過工業需求破壞及燃料轉換來平衡市場。」

items.title: Google不缺晶片與算力！AI變現無解讓市值蒸發6920億美元
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)過去一年一度被視為人工智慧(AI)熱潮最可能的贏家，股價在截至5月13日的一年間飆升逾150%，不僅創下歷史新高，更躋身標普500指數同期表現最佳的25檔成分股，漲幅遠超其他「美股七雄」。
然而，隨著Google母公司面臨AI人才流失、Gemini新模型延後推出，以及巨額資本支出難以證明回報等疑慮，市場風向迅速逆轉。Alphabet股價已較高點下跌15%，市值蒸發6,920億美元，並成為同期拖累標普500指數第二嚴重的個股。

AI人才接連出走 Gemini開發延誤

Alphabet近期股價跌勢的核心，在於市場開始質疑公司能否守住AI競爭優勢。除了投入巨資興建AI基礎設施，最強大模型Gemini 3.5 Pro也因持續改善程式編寫能力而延後推出；在這個領域，Alphabet已被認為落後Anthropic與OpenAI。
Google兩周前雖推出Gemini 3.7 Flash，卻未更新Gemini 3.5 Pro的上市時間。Janus Henderson分析師Divyaunsh Divatia表示，市場通常會給予擁有領先模型的AI贏家較高估值溢價，但Alphabet過去9至12個月享有的優勢已逐漸消退。
人才流失更令投資人不安。Google數月前有兩名高階員工轉投Anthropic與OpenAI；本月稍早，AI策略關鍵人物Jeff Dean離職創業，並帶走數名知名同事。Google DeepMind執行長Demis Hassabis也卸任，轉任董事長。這些消息導致Alphabet股價8月5日重挫4%，單日市值蒸發1,860億美元。
CFRA科技研究主管Angelo Zino表示，Alphabet確實出現人才外流，而投資人目前最關心的問題正是公司能否將AI轉化為收入。不過，AI人才爭奪並非Google獨有，Meta(META-US)曾以高達2億美元的多年薪酬挖走蘋果(AAPL-US)AI模型團隊主管，OpenAI也已從蘋果延攬逾400名員工。

巨額AI支出引疑慮 TPU仍是重要優勢

Google強調，公司AI產品推進速度正處於歷史高點，Gemini 3.7 Flash已成為成長最快的模型，Gemma下載次數也突破10億次。市場對Alphabet保持樂觀的理由，還包括自研張量處理器(TPU)及其累積的龐大運算能力。
然而，投資人日益要求大型AI開發商證明資料中心投資能帶來回報。Alphabet 8月初透過債券發行籌集250億美元，且提供較優渥的殖利率，進一步加深市場對其資金需求的疑慮。公司7月底公布財報後，股價也因資本支出龐大及自由現金流轉負而走低。
Divatia指出，Alphabet明年資本支出將顯著增加，並可能持續出現負自由現金流。公司已透過股權與債券市場籌資，以支應這場通往通用人工智慧(AGI)的資本競賽，令不少投資人感到不安。
儘管近期回檔，Alphabet過去12個月仍上漲65%，表現優於大盤及其他科技七巨頭。多頭認為，人事更迭也可能帶來新氣象，且Google擁有全球頂尖晶片與最大規模之一的運算資源，仍具備成功條件。不過，投資人接下來將要求管理層更清楚說明，AI究竟何時能轉化為實質營收與獲利成長。

items.title: 漲價還降規？三星Galaxy S26 FE比前代更貴 處理器改採聯發科
items.title_en: Price Hike and Feature Cut? Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Costs More Than Its Predecessor, Switches to MediaTek Processor
paras: 三星電子(005930-KR)周四(27日)發表Galaxy S26 FE，鎖定希望以低於旗艦機種的價格，取得部分高階功能的消費者。不過，新機售價不僅調高，處理器、記憶體、相機及裝置端人工智慧(AI)功能也有所取捨，市場定位顯得略為尷尬。
Galaxy S26 FE售價700美元，較前一代上漲50美元。在全產業面臨記憶體晶片短缺、手機價格頻頻上調之際，三星也未能避免漲價。新機將於9月3日起透過特定電信合作夥伴販售，三星官網及其他零售通路則於9月4日開賣。
為了將價格控制在700美元並避免更大幅度的漲價，三星捨棄標準版Galaxy S26採用的高通(QCOM-US)晶片，改搭效能較弱的聯發科(2454-TW)處理器。相機成像品質不及三星較昂貴的旗艦機種，記憶體也縮減至12GB，裝置端AI功能數量同樣較少。
不過，Galaxy S26 FE在軟體方面反而領先其他S26系列機種。新機出廠即搭載以Android 17為基礎的One UI 9；Galaxy S26、S26 Plus及S26 Ultra目前仍使用One UI 8.5，較新版本仍處於用戶測試階段，尚未全面推送。
硬體方面，Galaxy S26 FE配備6.7吋螢幕及120Hz更新率，仍能提供流暢的顯示體驗。4,900mAh電池搭配45W充電器時，約30分鐘可充至69%。
儘管受記憶體限制，新機仍保留Now Brief及Now Nudge等三星代表性AI功能，可主動向使用者顯示相關資訊。由Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google提供的Circle to Search視覺搜尋功能，如今也能辨識同一張圖片中的多個物件。
三星也導入My FanCam等最新相機軟體，可在已錄製的影片中自動裁切並鎖定特定人物，持續追蹤其移動、讓主體維持在畫面中央。Horizontal Lock功能則能在手機劇烈晃動甚至旋轉時，協助影片維持水平。
Galaxy S26 FE的問題在於市場定位不上不下。Google售價499美元的Pixel 10a等平價手機，已能充分滿足日常需求；售價1,300美元的Galaxy S26 Ultra則具備更強效能與更多高階功能，包括防止旁人窺視螢幕內容的Privacy Display。Galaxy S26 FE雖比旗艦機便宜，卻也因漲價及規格取捨，面臨兩端產品夾擊。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) announced the Galaxy S26 FE on Thursday (the 27th), targeting consumers who want some high‑end features at a price lower than flagship models. However, the new device not only has a higher price, but also compromises on the processor, memory, camera and on‑device AI functions, making its market positioning somewhat awkward.

The Galaxy S26 FE is priced at $700, $50 higher than the previous generation. Amid industry‑wide memory chip shortages and frequent phone price hikes, Samsung could not avoid a price increase. The device will be sold through selected telecom partners starting September 3, with Samsung’s website and other retail channels beginning sales on September 4.

To keep the price at $700 and avoid a larger hike, Samsung dropped the Qualcomm (QCOM-US) chip used in the standard Galaxy S26 and switched to a less powerful MediaTek (2454-TW) processor. The camera image quality falls short of Samsung’s more expensive flagship phones, memory is reduced to 12 GB, and the number of on‑device AI features is also lower.

However, the Galaxy S26 FE is ahead of other S26 series models in software. It ships with One UI 9 based on Android 17, while the Galaxy S26, S26 Plus and S26 Ultra are still on One UI 8.5, with the newer version still in user testing and not yet rolled out broadly.

Hardware-wise, the Galaxy S26 FE sports a 6.7‑inch display with a 120 Hz refresh rate, still delivering a smooth visual experience. Its 4,900 mAh battery paired with a 45 W charger can reach about 69 % charge in roughly 30 minutes.

Despite the memory limitation, the device retains Samsung’s signature AI features such as Now Brief and Now Nudge, which proactively show relevant information to users. Google’s Circle to Search visual search, provided by Alphabet (GOOGL-US), can now recognize multiple objects within the same image.

Samsung also adds the latest camera software like My FanCam, which automatically crops and locks onto a specific person in recorded video, continuously tracking their movement to keep the subject centered. The Horizontal Lock feature helps keep video level even when the phone is shaken or rotated.

The problem with the Galaxy S26 FE is its ambiguous market positioning. Budget phones like Google’s Pixel 10a, priced at $499, already meet everyday needs; the $1,300 Galaxy S26 Ultra offers stronger performance and more premium features, including a Privacy Display that prevents others from seeing screen content. While the S26 FE is cheaper than the flagship, its price hike and spec compromises leave it squeezed between the two ends of the product line.

items.title: 新創大利多！產創條例三讀：股票緩課稅上限衝千萬、天使輪與創投認列年限放寬至8年
items.title_en: Start‑up Boost! Industry Innovation Act Passes Third Reading: Stock Tax Deferral Cap Raised to 10 Million, Angel and VC Recognition Period Extended to 8 Years
paras: 立法院今（27）日三讀通過產業創新條例部分條文修正案，經濟部強調本次修法聚焦兩大核心領域：協助新創事業取得長期資金挹注，以及提高員工獎酬股票緩課額度，以大幅強化企業攬才與留才動能，意即新創企業給員工的股票獎酬緩課稅上限直接翻倍，從現行500萬元提高到1000萬元，大幅降低高階人才稅負；同時天使投資與創投適用優惠的新創事業認定年限，也從5年放寬到8年，讓新創團隊能獲得更充裕的資金支持。

在資本市場與新創投資環境優化方面，修正案針對第23條之1有限合夥創投事業投資新創租稅優惠進行結構性調整。考量創投機構成立初期尚需合理的案源開發與投資評估時間，修正案將第3至第5年度投資新創事業比例調整為實收出資總額的10%、20%與30%，並新增第6年度須達40%的門檻，大幅延伸創投機構的投資期程，為新創團隊提供更充裕的資金陪伴。同時，為貼近實務運作，修正案放寬外國公司認定標準，只要外國公司於台灣境內設立直接或間接控制之子公司或分公司即可適用，大幅提升創投機構的跨境投資彈性。
針對投資端與新創定義，第23條之2天使投資人租稅優惠及第23條之1的新創事業設立年限，同步由原本的未滿5年放寬至未滿8年，兩項條文皆自公布生效日起適用。此項修法不僅拉長政府資源挹注的時間軸，也讓國內新創相關規範達成一致標準，更貼近新創企業發展成熟的真實歷程與資金需求。
至於企業界最關注的留才機制，第19條之1大幅調高員工獎酬股票緩課額度，由現行的500萬元倍增至1000萬元。此條文自116年1月1日起適用，可大幅提升企業發放股票攬才的實質吸引力，降低高階關鍵人才的稅務負擔，全面提升台灣產業在國際競才戰中的戰略優勢。
經濟部強調，本次產創條例修法不僅能活絡新創投資環境，更可助益企業留住關鍵人才。後續經濟部將會同財政部儘速完備相關子法修訂，並舉辦說明會協助產業界充分了解實務申請流程，確保政策紅利精準落地，促進產業永續轉型。
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan passed a partial amendment to the Industry Innovation Act on the 27th, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs emphasized that the revision focuses on two core areas: helping start‑ups secure long‑term funding and raising the tax‑deferred stock award limit for employees. The cap for stock awards to staff is doubled from the current NT$5 million to NT$10 million, significantly lowering the tax burden on senior talent; at the same time, the eligibility period for start‑ups to receive angel‑investor and venture‑capital tax benefits is extended from five to eight years, giving new‑venture teams more ample financial support.

In terms of capital‑market and start‑up investment environment improvements, the amendment restructures the tax incentives for limited‑partnership venture‑capital firms investing in start‑ups under Article 23‑1. Recognizing that venture firms need reasonable time for deal sourcing and evaluation, the amendment sets the investment ratios for years three to five at 10%, 20% and 30% of paid‑in capital, and adds a 40% threshold for the sixth year, greatly extending the investment horizon and providing start‑ups with longer‑term capital support. It also relaxes the definition of foreign companies: any foreign firm that establishes a directly or indirectly controlled subsidiary or branch in Taiwan now qualifies, greatly enhancing cross‑border investment flexibility for venture firms.

Regarding the investment side and the definition of a start‑up, the tax benefits for angel investors under Article 23‑2 and the start‑up establishment period under Article 23‑1 are both extended from less than five years to less than eight years, effective from the date of promulgation. This change not only lengthens the timeline for government resource allocation but also aligns domestic start‑up regulations, better reflecting the real development cycle and funding needs of growing companies.

As for the talent‑retention mechanism most watched by businesses, Article 19‑1 dramatically raises the tax‑deferred stock award ceiling from NT$5 million to NT$10 million. The provision takes effect on 1 January 2027 and is expected to markedly increase the attractiveness of stock‑based recruitment, reduce the tax burden on key senior talent, and enhance Taiwan’s strategic advantage in the global talent‑competition race.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs stressed that the revision of the Industry Innovation Act will not only invigorate the start‑up investment environment but also help companies retain critical talent. The ministry will work with the Ministry of Finance to promptly finalize related subsidiary‑law amendments, hold briefings to help industry understand the application procedures, and ensure that policy benefits are precisely implemented to promote sustainable industrial transformation.

items.title: 鉅亨速報 - Factset 最新調查：聯茂(6213-TW)目標價調升至600元，幅度約5.26%
items.title_en: Juheng Flash – FactSet latest survey: Lian Mao (6213‑TW) target price raised to 600 TWD, about 5.26% increase
paras: 根據FactSet最新調查，共8位分析師，對聯茂(6213-TW)提出目標價估值：中位數由570元上修至600元，調升幅度5.26%。其中最高估值660元，最低估值134元。

paras_en: According to FactSet’s latest survey, eight analysts provided target price estimates for Lian Mao (6213‑TW): the median was revised up from 570 TWD to 600 TWD, a 5.26% increase. The highest estimate is 660 TWD and the lowest is 134 TWD.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉聯貸案「吸金」！搶攻供應鏈跨境商機 調高外幣放款年增目標至20%
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Investor Presentation: Syndicated Loans “Attract Capital”! Targeting Cross‑Border Supply‑Chain Opportunities and Raising Foreign‑Currency Loan Growth Goal to 20%
paras: 第一金控（2892-TW）今(27)日舉辦 2026 年第二季線上法人說明會，會中揭露獲利「金雞母」第一銀行上半年海外分行的最新營運成果，前三名依序是香港、布里斯本和倫敦，看好台商海外供應鏈商機，一銀並調升外幣放款成長目標至20%，並說明高資產財富管理發展策略，展現集團在全球化與跨境金融商機上的前瞻布局。
第一銀行副總經理蔡淑慧公布一銀海外分行前三大獲利市場表現：第一名由香港分行蟬聯，累計賺取 2,828 萬美元，雖因降息影響、利差收窄而年減 9.3%，但放款總量仍維持成長；第二名為澳洲布里斯本分行，獲利 1,083 萬美元，年增 1.2%；第三名為倫敦分行，獲利 1,054 萬美元，年減 23% 主因是去年基期較高（去年同期有股票擔保評價利益收回 240 萬美元），但其放款動能依然維持擴張。
蔡淑慧指出，放款仍是下半年的核心驅動動能。一銀今年在科技業聯貸案斬獲極豐，整體放款目標維持 9% 到 10%。因應跨境供應鏈重組，一銀正式將外幣放款成長目標大幅調升至 17% 至 20%。
在財務操作上，一銀透露近期已提早進行「換券」策略，將長天期債券調配改為短天期債券，以在利差收窄的環境中爭取交易獲利；受惠於此，上半年金融市場操作收益（含剩餘資金操作）逾 200億元，預估全年有機會突破 400 億元。
此外，一銀高資產管理業務表現極為驚人，截至目前相關手續費收益已達近 16 億元，較去年同期的 8 億元成長將近一倍，帶動整體財富管理手續費成長 30%。因此，第一金控將財富管理手續費收入目標上調 25%，整體手續費目標也同步上調 20%。
最後，針對併購議題，第一金控表態對公公併或公民併維持開放態度，將依循「遵守法令、符合長期戰略營運綜效、兼顧股東客戶員工權益」三原則與互補綜效等面向審慎評估，現階段仍將聚焦核心業務的內部有機成長。
paras_en: First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) held its Q2 2026 online corporate briefing today (27th). The presentation disclosed the profit “golden goose” – First Bank’s latest overseas branch performance for the first half of the year. The top three markets were Hong Kong, Brisbane and London. The bank is optimistic about Taiwanese firms’ overseas supply‑chain opportunities, has raised its foreign‑currency loan growth target to 20%, and outlined its high‑net‑worth wealth‑management development strategy, showcasing the group’s forward‑looking positioning in globalization and cross‑border financial opportunities.

Vice President of First Bank, Cai Shuhui, announced the top three profit‑generating overseas branches: Hong Kong retained the first place with cumulative earnings of US$28.28 million, down 9.3% year‑on‑year due to rate cuts and narrowing spreads, though total loan volume still grew; Brisbane, Australia ranked second with profit of US$10.83 million, up 1.2% YoY; London came third with profit of US$10.54 million, down 23% mainly because the prior year’s base was high (last year’s same period included a US$2.4 million stock‑collateral valuation benefit), yet its loan momentum remains expanding.

Cai Shuhui noted that lending remains the core driver for the second half of the year. This year First Bank secured substantial loan commitments in technology‑sector syndicated deals, keeping the overall loan growth target at 9%‑10%. In response to cross‑border supply‑chain restructuring, the bank formally lifted its foreign‑currency loan growth target dramatically to a range of 17%‑20%.

On the financial‑operations side, the bank disclosed that it has recently accelerated a “bond‑swap” strategy, shifting allocations from long‑term to short‑term bonds to capture trading profits in an environment of narrowing spreads. Benefiting from this, the bank’s financial‑market trading earnings (including surplus‑cash operations) exceeded NT$20 billion in the first half, and it estimates the full‑year figure could surpass NT$40 billion.

In addition, First Bank’s high‑net‑worth management business performed exceptionally, with related fee income already near NT$1.6 billion, almost double the NT$800 million earned in the same period last year, driving a 30% rise in overall wealth‑management fee revenue. Consequently, First Financial Holding raised its wealth‑management fee‑income target by 25% and lifted the overall fee target by 20%.

Finally, regarding M&A, First Financial Holding expressed an open stance toward both corporate‑to‑corporate and public‑to‑public mergers, stating that any deal will be carefully evaluated based on three principles – compliance with laws, alignment with long‑term strategic synergies, and protection of shareholders, customers and employees – as well as complementary benefits. For now, the focus remains on organic growth of core businesses.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉估央行續凍息、房市量縮價平靠自住剛需撐盤 今年房貸業務將成長5%
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Investor Briefing Predicts Continued Rate Freeze, Shrinking Volume and Stable Prices in Housing Market; Mortgage Business Expected to Grow 5% This Year
paras: 第一金控（2892-TW）於今 (27) 日召開 2026 年第二季線上法人說明會，由第一金控總經理方螢基主持。面對美國聯準會（Fed）利率前景未明，認為 Fed 年底前並無升息必要性，台灣央行為兼顧K型經濟的均衡，下半年也可望續「凍息」，房市呈現「量縮價平」。因逢新青安2.0與3.0交替之際， 帶動一銀8 月新青安占整體房貸比重也拉升至 37%，今年房貸業務可望較去年成長5%。
在總體經濟層面，第一金控釋出極為樂觀的評估，在 AI 伺服器、高階晶片、高效能運算（HPC）及雲端基礎建設等強勁需求帶動下，國內出口與民間投資持續展現驚人成長。受惠於此，第一金控內部最新估算，2026 年台灣全年經濟成長率（GDP）將強勢落在 10% 至 11% 的高成長區間。
在利率政策方面，第一金控研判美國聯準會（Fed）年底前並無升息必要性；台灣央行短期內亦將維持利率不變。第一金控副總經理莊淑娟解釋，這主要是為了兼顧國內「K 型經濟」發展。目前高科技業雖然極為熱絡，但部分傳統產業營運仍相當慘淡，利率政策必須同時權衡不同產業的生存空間。
針對市場高度關注的房地產授信與高槓桿「四貸同堂」危機，第一銀行副總經理蔡淑慧於法說會上公開澄清，強調所謂房貸、信貸等重疊的「四貸同堂」重槓桿授信，在第一銀行內「是完全沒有」。她強調，此現象在同業間的比例也不高，對一銀及整體金融市場影響非常有限。
在房貸與新青安業務部分，一銀將今年房貸成長目標定在 5%。受新舊制度交替與程序因素影響，7 月受理戶數為 344 戶，但 8 月截至 21 日為止已迅速衝上 403 戶（受理金額逾 31 億元），顯示自住剛性需求依然蓬勃，8 月新青安占整體房貸比重也拉升至 37%。
展望下半年國內房市，蔡淑慧預期整體市場將呈現「量縮價平」。由於建商大多資金充裕，寧願維持價格穩定，改以送裝潢、送家電設備等折中手段，也不會輕易直接調降價格；不過，過去漲幅過快、需求量較低的蛋白區，近期價格已有部分鬆動跡象。
paras_en: First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) held its Q2 2026 online corporate briefing today (27th), chaired by General Manager Fang Ying‑ji. Facing an uncertain Fed rate outlook, the company believes there is no need for the Fed to raise rates before year‑end, and that the Taiwan central bank, to balance the K‑shaped economy, can likely keep rates frozen in the second half. The housing market is showing “shrinking volume and stable prices.” With the transition from the New Youth Housing 2.0 to 3.0 program, First Bank’s share of new‑home loans in total mortgage lending rose to 37% in August, and mortgage business is expected to grow 5% year‑over‑year.

On the macro‑economic front, First Financial Holding issued a very optimistic outlook, noting that strong demand for AI servers, high‑end chips, high‑performance computing (HPC) and cloud infrastructure is driving impressive growth in Taiwan’s exports and private investment. Benefiting from this, the firm’s latest internal estimate puts Taiwan’s 2026 GDP growth at a robust 10%‑11%.

Regarding rate policy, First Financial Holding assesses that the U.S. Fed has no need to raise rates before year‑end, and the Taiwan central bank will keep rates unchanged in the short term. Deputy General Manager Zhuang Shujian explained that this is to accommodate the domestic “K‑shaped” economy, where high‑tech sectors are booming but many traditional industries remain weak, requiring a balanced rate stance to preserve the survival space of different sectors.

Addressing market concerns over real‑estate credit and the high‑leverage “four‑loan‑together” issue, First Bank Deputy General Manager Cai Shuhui clarified at the briefing that the alleged overlapping mortgage and personal loan “four‑loan‑together” heavy‑leverage credit does not exist at First Bank. She added that such a phenomenon is also rare among peers and has very limited impact on the bank and the overall financial market.

For mortgage and New Youth Housing business, First Bank set a 5% growth target for this year’s mortgages. Due to the transition between old and new systems and procedural factors, the number of applications in July was 344, but by August 21 it had quickly risen to 403 applications (with loan amounts exceeding NT$3.1 billion), indicating that rigid owner‑occupier demand remains strong, and New Youth Housing’s share of total mortgages rose to 37% in August.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Cai Shuhui expects the domestic housing market to show “shrinking volume and stable prices.” Since most developers have ample cash, they prefer to keep prices stable and use incentives such as free interior decoration or appliances rather than cutting prices outright; however, in the previously fast‑rising, low‑demand “protein” segment, prices have shown some recent softening.

items.title: BenQ衝刺智慧照明應用銷售增近3成 推三款新品
items.title_en: BenQ pushes smart lighting application sales up nearly 30% and launches three new products
paras: 佳世達(2352-TW)旗下顯示科技品牌BenQ衝刺智慧照明應用，今(27)日發表三大新品，BenQ台灣區總經理邱慧玲表示，旗下螢幕掛燈於2026上半年銷售年增近3成，展現消費者對高品質照明體驗的高度重視。
邱慧玲表示，現代人長時間面對螢幕，也在工作、閱讀、休息等不同生活場景中切換，照明需求已從單純的「亮度」進一步走向舒適、健康與情境化；BenQ長期深耕智慧照明領域，持續以專業光學設計回應使用者需求。
此次BenQ推出產品包刮聚焦桌面工作與居家閱讀場景、推出專為雙螢幕工作者打造的ScreenBar；Max、iMac使用者量身設計的iScreenBar，以及全新閱讀立燈NookLight。
BenQ表示，新品延續品牌專業光學設計與智慧調光技術，重新定義現代居家照明體驗，透過頂尖光學科技，全面賦能更高效、井然有序的智慧辦公與居家閱讀環境，三款新品也自即日起上市。
paras_en: BenQ, the display technology brand under Qisda (2352‑TW), is sprinting in smart lighting applications. Today (27th) it unveiled three major new products. BenQ Taiwan General Manager Chiu Hui‑ling said its monitor‑mounted lamps will see sales increase by nearly 30% year‑on‑year in the first half of 2026, reflecting consumers’ strong emphasis on high‑quality lighting experiences.

Chiu said modern people spend long hours in front of screens and switch among work, reading, and rest in various life scenarios; lighting needs have moved beyond simple “brightness” toward comfort, health, and contextualization. BenQ has long cultivated the smart lighting field, continuously responding to user needs with professional optical design.

This time BenQ’s product lineup includes a ScreenBar designed for dual‑monitor workers, an iScreenBar tailored for Mac Max and iMac users, and a brand‑new reading floor lamp called NookLight, focusing on desktop work and home‑reading scenarios.

BenQ said the new products continue the brand’s professional optical design and smart dimming technology, redefining the modern home lighting experience. Leveraging cutting‑edge optical technology, they fully empower more efficient and orderly smart office and home‑reading environments. The three new products are on sale starting today.

items.title: 振宇五金將達全台第100店里程碑 搶高齡化居家安全商機
items.title_en: Zhenyu Hardware to Reach 100 Stores Nationwide Milestone, Seizing Aging Home Safety Market Opportunity
paras: 連鎖五金業者振宇五金(2947-TW)今(27)日召開法說會時指出，預計第四季將完成全台第100店里程碑，振宇五金總經理洪國展樂觀看待，台灣居家修繕市場在老屋、高齡化和在宅照護等長期結構性需求支撐下，營業毛利率改善趨勢將延續。
振宇五金上半年合併營收11.88億元，年增7.14%，營業利益5,612萬元，年增9.38%，稅後純益4160萬元，年增9.08%，每股純益(EPS)1.78元，整體毛利率達41.45%，營收和獲利維持穩健成長。
振宇五金表示，毛利率表現主要受惠商品組合持續優化，其中，毛利較佳的自有品牌銷售貢獻提升，另受市場售價調整、年度廠商達標折扣和存貨利益損失回轉等因素挹注。
振宇五金旗下第99家據點新竹竹東店預計9月19日開幕，並力拚第四季完成第100家門市布局。
振宇五金看人口結構與消費型態改變，百店只是階段性里程碑，中長期規劃每年6-8%的門市成長數，長期依整體市場結構朝200家門市發展，並同步結合電商來擴大服務密度和市場覆蓋率，EC銷售額上半年年增達65%。
而自有品牌是振宇五金強化商品差異化的重要一環，振宇五金說明，以MIT商品為主要發展方向，不以增加SKU數量為目標，優先布局高周轉、消耗性和經市場驗證的商品。
面對台灣高齡化及在宅照護需求增加，長照3.0相關經費規模達1153億元，振宇五金看準此龐大商機正積極拓展高齡居家安全市場，進一步串聯「點工成金」派工服務，提供「商品購買+到府安裝」一條龍，去年點工派工服務數已成長66.4%。
而在會員與數位經營方面，截至上半年振宇五金會員總數達70.83萬人，年增13.04%，會員回購率達69.35%，會員營收占整體比重55.9%，會員平均客單價較非會員高出約55%。
paras_en: During a legal briefing held today (27th), chain hardware retailer Zhenyu Hardware (2947‑TW) said it expects to complete its 100th store nationwide in the fourth quarter. General manager Hong Guozhan is optimistic, noting that Taiwan’s home repair market, supported by long‑term structural demand from aging homes, an aging population and in‑home care, will keep the upward trend in operating gross margin.

In the first half of the year, Zhenyu Hardware reported consolidated revenue of NT$1.188 billion, up 7.14% year‑on‑year, operating profit of NT$56.12 million, up 9.38%, net profit after tax of NT$41.60 million, up 9.08%, and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.78. The overall gross margin reached 41.45%, with revenue and profit maintaining solid growth.

Zhenyu Hardware said the gross‑margin performance was mainly driven by continued optimization of its product mix, including higher‑margin sales of its own‑brand items, as well as market price adjustments, annual vendor‑target discounts and the reversal of inventory‑loss provisions.
The company’s 99th location, the Zhudong store in Hsinchu, is slated to open on September 19, and Zhenyu is pushing to complete its 100th store layout in the fourth quarter.

Zhenyu sees changes in demographics and consumer behavior, noting that the 100‑store mark is only a transitional milestone. Its medium‑ to long‑term plan targets 6‑8% annual store growth, aiming for about 200 stores overall, while integrating e‑commerce to increase service density and market coverage. E‑commerce sales grew 65% year‑on‑year in the first half.

Its own‑brand strategy is a key part of product differentiation. Zhenyu explained that it focuses on MIT products as the main development direction, not on expanding SKU count, but on prioritizing high‑turnover, consumable items that have been market‑validated.

Facing Taiwan’s aging population and rising in‑home care needs, with Long‑Term Care 3.0 funding reaching NT$115.3 billion, Zhenyu is targeting this huge opportunity by actively expanding into the senior home‑safety market. It is linking its “point‑work to gold” dispatch service to offer a one‑stop “product purchase + home installation” solution; last year, the point‑work dispatch volume grew 66.4%.

As of the first half, Zhenyu’s total membership reached 708,300, up 13.04% year‑on‑year. The member repurchase rate was 69.35%, members accounted for 55.9% of total revenue, and the average spend per member was about 55% higher than that of non‑members.

items.title: 房貸逾放暴增引恐慌 金管會澄清：單一銀行申報搞烏龍「校正回歸」
items.title_en: Mortgage Delinquency Surge Triggers Panic; Financial Supervisory Commission Clarifies: Single Bank Reporting Error Leads to Data Correction
paras: 金管會罕見出現統計數據校正回歸！國銀7月房貸逾放餘額驚傳單月暴增7.8億元，引發風控疑慮。金管會今(27)日澄清，主因是單一銀行6月前申報錯置、少報逾8億元；若將漏報金額還原回6月(實為94.64億元)，7月逾放(94.25億元)實際上「不增反減」約0.39億元。官員強調，整體房貸逾放比仍處0.08%低檔，資產品質健全。
銀行局原本公布的資料顯示，國銀6月房貸逾放為86.45億元，7月激增至94.25億元，看起來像是單月暴增7.8億元。但真相是，有一家銀行過去一直「少報」，並在7月一次把漏報的8.2億元塞回帳面上。若將這筆漏報金額還原回6月，6月的真實逾放其實高達94.64億元；如此一比，7月(94.25億元)實際上比6月(94.64億元)還減少了近0.39億元，房貸品質並未惡化。
針對校正回歸的原因，銀行局副局長張嘉魁說明，某家銀行的房貸逾放，因在科目分類上的認知差異導致少報，目前已要求其針對過去一段期間的數據進行全面清查與補正。
媒體追問，該行到底是只有今年上半年少報，還是漏報好幾年？張嘉魁回應，「該行還在清查中」，因此尚未確定漏報的起始時間與涵蓋期間，待該行清查完畢，確定所有受影響的歷史月份後，會再進行「更正申報」，屆時金管會公告的報表才會更新還原各月份更正後的歷史數據。
針對外界疑慮房貸資產品質是否惡化，張嘉魁強調，即便將該筆數據調整回歸，整體國銀的房貸逾放比率仍維持在0.08%的歷史低檔區間，資產品質持續保持穩健。他指出，隨著國銀整體房貸放款總量成長，逾放金額難免隨之微幅增減，監理重點應觀察整體逾放比率，而非單一金額波動。
此外，針對市場傳出金管會擬約談「逾放連續攀升之民營銀行」說法，張嘉魁予以否認，強調並無相關規劃。金管會日常監理均會按月審視各銀行資產品質與控管機制，並在必要時要求銀行說明財業務狀況，整體國銀房貸業務目前風控良好。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) unusually issued a statistical data correction! The national banking sector's mortgage delinquency balance for July was reported to have surged by NT$7.8 billion in a single month, sparking risk‑control concerns. The FSC clarified today (the 27th) that the main cause was a single bank’s mis‑reporting before June, under‑reporting delinquent amounts by more than NT$8 billion. If the omitted amount is restored to June (which should have been NT$94.64 billion), July’s delinquency (NT$94.25 billion) actually “decreased” by about NT$0.39 billion. Officials emphasized that the overall mortgage delinquency ratio remains low at 0.08%, indicating sound asset quality.

The data originally released by the Banking Bureau showed national bank mortgage delinquency at NT$86.45 billion in June, jumping to NT$94.25 billion in July, which appeared to be a monthly surge of NT$7.8 billion. The truth is that one bank had been consistently under‑reporting and in July finally added the missed NT$8.2 billion back to the books. When that amount is moved back to June, the true June delinquency was actually NT$94.64 billion; compared with that, July’s figure (NT$94.25 billion) is about NT$0.39 billion lower, meaning mortgage quality has not deteriorated.

Regarding the reason for the correction, Banking Bureau Deputy Director Zhang Jiakui explained that the bank’s mortgage delinquency was under‑reported due to a different understanding of the account classification, and the bureau has now asked the bank to conduct a comprehensive review and correction of its data for the relevant period.

The media asked whether the under‑reporting occurred only in the first half of this year or spanned several years. Zhang replied, “The bank is still conducting the review,” so the start date and coverage period of the omission have not yet been determined. Once the bank completes its review and confirms all affected historical months, it will submit corrected reports, and the FSC will update the published statements to reflect the revised historical data.

Addressing external concerns about a possible deterioration in mortgage asset quality, Zhang stressed that even after adjusting the data, the overall mortgage delinquency ratio for national banks remains at a historically low 0.08%, and asset quality stays robust. He noted that as the total volume of mortgage lending grows, delinquent amounts will naturally fluctuate slightly, and supervisory focus should be on the overall delinquency ratio rather than isolated amount swings.

Furthermore, regarding rumors that the FSC planned to interview “private banks with continuously rising delinquencies,” Zhang denied such plans, emphasizing that no related program exists. The FSC’s routine supervision reviews each bank’s asset quality and control mechanisms monthly and, when necessary, requires banks to explain their financial and business conditions. Overall, the national banking sector’s mortgage business currently has sound risk control.

items.title: Salesforce AI變現出現進展Jefferies調高目標價至300美元、股價大漲21%
items.title_en: Salesforce AI Monetization Shows Progress; Jefferies Raises Target to $300, Stock Jumps 21%
paras: 2026年08月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Salesforce(CRM-US)最新財報釋出AI業務逐步轉化為實際收入的訊號，緩解市場對AI可能衝擊傳統企業軟體商業模式的疑慮。Salesforce股價大漲21%，Jefferies維持「買進」評等，並將目標價由250美元調高至300美元，調升20%。
市場關注焦點落在Salesforce的AI代理平台Agentforce。德意志銀行分析師指出，第2季Agentforce訂單中，有一半來自客戶重新購買已使用完畢的額度。這代表部分企業客戶不只是在測試AI功能，而是在實際使用後持續增加採購，讓Agentforce開始展現重複性收入的潛力。

Agentforce開始出現重複採購AI變現能力受關注
對Salesforce而言，這項數據的重要性在於，市場先前擔心生成式AI快速發展可能削弱傳統企業軟體的價值，但客戶持續補充Agentforce使用額度，顯示AI功能已開始融入企業日常工作流程，並逐步轉化為實際營收。
Salesforce與AI模型業者Anthropic深化合作，也被德意志銀行視為另一項正面訊號。分析師認為，大型AI模型能力提升未必會取代Salesforce，反而可能讓Salesforce既有的企業資料、應用程式與治理工具，成為企業導入外部AI模型的重要平台。
不過，德意志銀行也提醒，目前數據仍不足以完全證明Agentforce已能大規模創造收入，但至少提供更具體的證據，降低投資人對Salesforce可能遭AI取代，以及AI投資難以變現的疑慮。
在AI業務進展與財報表現改善帶動下，市場重新評估Salesforce的成長前景。Jefferies最新將Salesforce目標價由250美元上調至300美元，同時維持「買進」評等，反映華爾街對公司AI商業化進展的信心升溫。

paras_en: August 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Salesforce (CRM‑US) released its latest earnings, showing signals that its AI business is gradually turning into actual revenue, easing market concerns that AI could disrupt the traditional enterprise‑software business model. Salesforce’s share price surged 21%, Jefferies kept its “Buy” rating and raised the target price from $250 to $300, a 20% increase.

The market’s focus is on Salesforce’s AI agent platform, Agentforce. Deutsche Bank analysts noted that in Q2, half of Agentforce orders came from customers repurchasing used‑up capacity. This indicates that some enterprise customers are not just testing AI features but are continuously increasing purchases after real‑world use, showing the platform’s potential for recurring revenue.

Agentforce’s emerging recurring AI monetization capability is drawing attention. For Salesforce, this data matters because the market had previously feared that the rapid rise of generative AI might erode the value of traditional enterprise software, but customers’ ongoing top‑ups of Agentforce capacity show AI functions are being embedded into daily workflows and gradually converting into actual earnings.

Salesforce’s deepening partnership with AI model provider Anthropic is also seen by Deutsche Bank as another positive signal. Analysts believe that advances in large‑model AI capabilities are unlikely to replace Salesforce; instead, they may make Salesforce’s existing enterprise data, applications, and governance tools a key platform for companies adopting external AI models.

However, Deutsche Bank cautions that the data is still insufficient to fully prove that Agentforce can generate revenue at scale, but it at least provides more concrete evidence, reducing investor worries that Salesforce could be displaced by AI or that AI investments are hard to monetize.

With progress in AI operations and improved earnings performance, the market is re‑evaluating Salesforce’s growth outlook. Jefferies recently lifted Salesforce’s target price from $250 to $300 while maintaining a “Buy” rating, reflecting Wall Street’s growing confidence in the company’s AI commercialization progress.

items.title: 全華爾街都在質疑她！美銀策略師仍喊標普500恐跌7.5%
items.title_en: Wall Street Is Questioning Her! BofA Strategist Still Says S&P 500 Could Drop 7.5%
paras: 在華爾街當最悲觀的策略師並不容易，美國銀行美股及量化策略主管蘇布拉曼尼安(Savita Subramanian)便深有體會。她將標普500指數年底目標維持在7,100點，是《彭博》調查逾20名策略師中最低，意味著指數將較周三收盤下跌7.5%。
蘇布拉曼尼安表示，自己因這項預測遭受的批評是多年來最多。客戶過去通常提醒她不要過度樂觀，如今卻不斷追問她何時才要上調目標。
即使摩根大通及華爾街資深策略師亞德尼(Ed Yardeni)等同業近幾周陸續調高預測，她仍堅持原有看法。調整後，《彭博》調查的年底目標平均值已升至7,901點，較周三收盤高2.9%，也比她的目標高出11%。
蘇布拉曼尼安主要擔心，企業為建設人工智慧(AI)基礎設施而提高槓桿，加上信用利差異常狹窄，可能預示信用周期即將惡化。她雖承認超大規模雲端業者及大型科技股具有吸引力，但認為整個族群正處於即將落後大盤的邊緣，投資人至多應維持中立配置，甚至減碼。
輝達(NVDA-US)預估下一會計年度營收將成長70%，周四再次點燃AI行情，也緩解市場對AI支出動能放緩的疑慮。不過，蘇布拉曼尼安表示，在轉為看多以前，她需要看到企業大規模資本支出真正開始帶來收入，尤其是AI投資的變現跡象。
她指出，目前市場對運算能力的需求極為強勁，這使本輪科技熱潮不同於1990年代末的網路泡沫。雖然企業槓桿快速升高，但如今借款公司的商業前景及資產負債表，也普遍優於當年的網路企業。
在選股方面，蘇布拉曼尼安最看好大型價值股，包括能源、金融及部分軟體公司，這些企業業務體質健康，資產負債表也相對乾淨。
今年成長型及價值型指數成分調整後，價值股的吸引力進一步提高。部分半導體股由價值型轉入成長型，軟體公司及若干超大規模雲端業者則被納入價值型。她認為，價值股是篩選優質企業、同時避免支付過高估值的直接方式。
paras_en: Being the most pessimistic strategist on Wall Street isn’t easy, and Bank of America’s U.S. equities and quantitative strategy head Savita Subramanian knows that well. She keeps her year‑end target for the S&P 500 at 7,100 points, the lowest among more than 20 strategists surveyed by Bloomberg, implying a 7.5% decline from Wednesday’s close.

Subramanian says the criticism she’s received for this forecast is the most she’s faced in years. Clients who once warned her not to be overly optimistic are now repeatedly asking when she will raise the target.

Even as peers such as JPMorgan and veteran Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni have been nudging their forecasts higher in recent weeks, she sticks to her view. After the adjustments, the Bloomberg survey’s average year‑end target has risen to 7,901 points, 2.9% above Wednesday’s close and 11% above her own target.

Subramanian’s main worry is that companies are increasing leverage to build AI infrastructure while credit spreads remain unusually tight, a possible sign that the credit cycle is about to deteriorate. She acknowledges that mega‑cloud providers and large‑cap tech stocks are attractive, but believes the whole group is on the brink of underperforming the broader market, so investors should stay neutral or even trim exposure.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) forecasts a 70% revenue jump for the next fiscal year, reigniting the AI rally on Thursday and easing concerns that AI spending momentum is slowing. Still, Subramanian says she needs to see large‑scale corporate cap‑ex actually translating into revenue – especially clear monetisation of AI investments – before turning bullish.

She notes that current demand for compute power is extremely strong, making this tech wave different from the late‑1990s internet bubble. Although corporate leverage is rising quickly, today’s borrowing companies generally have better business prospects and balance sheets than the dot‑com era firms.
In stock selection, Subramanian favours large‑cap value names, including energy, financials and certain software firms, which have healthy business fundamentals and relatively clean balance sheets.

After this year’s rebalancing of growth and value index constituents, the appeal of value stocks has risen further. Some semiconductor stocks moved from value to growth, while software companies and several mega‑cloud providers were added to value. She sees value stocks as a direct way to pick quality companies while avoiding over‑paying valuations.

items.title: 輝達財報藏警訊？貨賣愈多、收款愈慢 應收帳款暴增63%
items.title_en: NVIDIA Financial Report Hints at Red Flags? More Sales, Slower Collections, Accounts Receivable Soars 63%
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)日前再度交出優於預期並上調財測的亮眼成績單，2027會計年度第二季業績及銷售展望均超越市場預估，激勵股價周四(27日)走高。然而，財報中應收帳款暴增、供應鏈承諾擴大及自由現金流驟減等數據，也浮現值得投資人警惕的訊號。

應收帳款暴增 客戶集中度升高

今年1月至7月，輝達應收帳款淨額由385億美元攀升至631億美元，增幅約63%，代表公司已完成出貨、卻尚未收到貨款的訂單快速增加。
D.A. Davidson科技研究主管盧里亞(Gil Luria)表示，這項數據值得持續關注，因為輝達的交易規模龐大，且正為遙遠的未來作出巨額承諾。
投資銀行預估，輝達應收帳款未來幾年還會繼續膨脹。美國銀行預測，應收帳款將由2027年1月約710億美元，增至2028年的1,130億美元及2029年的1,470億美元，兩年間增幅達107%。
摩根士丹利的預測更高，估計輝達應收帳款將由2027年的786億美元，增加至2029年1月的1,710億美元，增幅達117%。
客戶集中度同樣引發疑慮。輝達在季度文件中表示，僅五名直接客戶就占應收帳款總額的70%，主要為大型雲端運算業者。相較之下，去年同期則是三名直接客戶占56%，顯示公司收款來源愈來愈集中於少數大型客戶。

承諾金額翻倍 自由現金流腰斬

在尚未收回的貨款增加之際，輝達為客戶及供應商提供的支援承諾也大幅擴張，使外界對AI產業「循環融資」的批評升溫。
花旗周四報告指出，輝達的相關承諾由第一季1,190億美元增至第二季2,790億美元，成長超過一倍，主要來自記憶體晶片零組件需求。
高盛形容這些承諾「規模可觀」。輝達管理層目前支援客戶的財務承諾總額達3,660億美元，包括2,790億美元供應與產能承諾，其中多數與記憶體有關；另有290億美元雲端服務協議、250億美元資料中心租約、250億美元股權投資及50億美元資本支出。
這還不包括輝達本月稍早與多家私募股權巨頭共同宣布的5,000億美元融資安排，市場因此更加關注公司為支撐AI基礎建設及客戶需求所承擔的資金風險。
受到資產負債表壓力影響，輝達第二季自由現金流由第一季490億美元驟降至214億美元，遠低於市場預期的約430億美元。
Truist Securities分析師史坦(William Stein)指出，輝達向投資等級客戶放寬付款條件，使應收帳款周轉天數較前一季增加15天，拖累自由現金流。Freedom Capital Markets科技研究主管米克斯(Paul Meeks)認為，這項變化可能只是暫時現象，主要與輝達積極擴大新一代Vera Rubin晶片系統部署有關，但付款期限延長仍值得密切追蹤。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) recently delivered another stellar earnings report that beat expectations and raised its financial guidance, with Q2 of fiscal 2027 and sales outlook surpassing market estimates, propelling the stock higher on Thursday (27th). However, the report also revealed a sharp rise in accounts receivable, expanded supply‑chain commitments, and a sudden drop in free cash flow—signals that investors should watch closely.

Accounts receivable surged as customer concentration increased. From January to July, NVIDIA’s net accounts receivable climbed from $38.5 billion to $63.1 billion, a 63% jump, indicating that the company has shipped goods but has not yet received payment for a growing number of orders.

Gil Luria, senior research analyst at D.A. Davidson Technology, said the data warrants ongoing attention because NVIDIA’s transaction volume is massive and it is making huge commitments for the distant future.

Investment banks predict that NVIDIA’s accounts receivable will continue to expand in the coming years. JPMorgan forecasts that accounts receivable will rise from about $71 billion in January 2027 to $113 billion in 2028 and $147 billion in 2029, a 107% increase over two years.
Morgan Stanley’s forecast is even higher, estimating accounts receivable will grow from $78.6 billion in 2027 to $171 billion in January 2029, a 117% increase.

Customer concentration also raises concerns. NVIDIA disclosed that only five direct customers accounted for 70% of accounts receivable, mainly large cloud‑computing firms. In the same period last year, three direct customers accounted for 56%, showing that payment sources are becoming increasingly concentrated among a few large clients.
Commitments doubled as uncollected receivables rose, expanding NVIDIA’s support commitments to customers and suppliers and intensifying criticism of the AI industry’s “circular financing.”
Citigroup reported on Thursday that NVIDIA’s related commitments rose from $119 billion in Q1 to $279 billion in Q2, more than doubling, largely driven by demand for memory‑chip components.

Goldman Sachs described these commitments as “substantial.” NVIDIA’s management currently supports customers with $366 billion in financial commitments, including $279 billion in supply and capacity commitments—most of which relate to memory—plus $29 billion in cloud‑service agreements, $25 billion in data‑center leases, $25 billion in equity investments, and $5 billion in capital expenditures.

This does not include NVIDIA’s earlier announcement this month of a $500 billion financing arrangement with several private‑equity giants, further heightening market focus on the capital risk NVIDIA bears to support AI infrastructure and customer demand.
Due to balance‑sheet pressure, NVIDIA’s free cash flow fell sharply from $49 billion in Q1 to $21.4 billion in Q2, far below the market’s expectation of about $43 billion.

Truist Securities analyst William Stein noted that NVIDIA’s relaxed payment terms for investment‑grade customers increased accounts‑receivable days by 15 days compared to the previous quarter, dragging down free cash flow. Paul Meeks, senior research analyst at Freedom Capital Markets, believes the change may be temporary, mainly tied to NVIDIA’s aggressive expansion of the new‑generation Vera Rubin chip system, but the extended payment terms remain worth close monitoring.

items.title: Fed不能再等了！哈瑪克直言現在就是升息時機
items.title_en: Fed Can’t Wait Any Longer! Hammack Says Now Is the Time to Raise Rates
paras: 克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)周四(27日)再次呼籲升息，直言聯準會(Fed)目前的利率政策並未對經濟形成限制，面對持續高於目標的通膨，「現在就是採取行動的時候」。
哈瑪克在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾接受CNBC訪問時表示，周三公布的數據顯示，通膨折合年率仍在3%左右。儘管近幾個月物價單月漲幅有所放緩，Fed仍有必要收緊貨幣政策，讓經濟受到一定程度的抑制，才能協助通膨回落至2%目標。
Fed偏好的7月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增3.7%，排除食品及能源價格的核心PCE年增率則為3.3%。哈瑪克警告，美國通膨已連續超過五年高於Fed目標，拖得愈久，未來壓低物價的難度就愈大，家庭與企業承受的痛苦也將更加嚴重。
哈瑪克是Fed今年的利率決策投票委員。她在7月會議與另外兩名官員反對維持利率不變，主張升息1碼。Fed當時連續第五次將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在3.5%至3.75%。
她指出，當前金融環境看不出貨幣政策具有限制性。市場仍能出現兆美元級首次公開募股(IPO)，企業發債規模也屢創新高，顯示目前利率並未明顯壓抑借貸或經濟成長。
哈瑪克最擔心的是，通膨長期超標可能讓民眾形成根深柢固的通膨心理，進而改變消費決策。她近期與賓州伊利市的勞工交流時，許多人表示，即使每天工作並擁有穩定職位，仍難以維持生計，甚至無法在周末帶孩子買一支冰淇淋。
今年物價壓力主要來自伊朗戰爭、關稅及AI相關需求。Fed通常會忽略被視為暫時性的供給衝擊，但部分官員擔憂其影響可能逐漸滲入整體經濟。市場目前預期Fed在9月及10月會議仍將按兵不動，最快可能等到12月才會升息。
paras_en: Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Beth Hammack called for another rate hike on Thursday (the 27th), stating that the Fed’s current interest‑rate policy is not restraining the economy and, faced with inflation that remains above target, “now is the time to act.”

Hammack told CNBC in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, that data released on Wednesday showed inflation running at about a 3% annualized rate. Even though monthly price gains have slowed in recent months, the Fed still needs to tighten monetary policy enough to curb the economy and help bring inflation back down to the 2% goal.

The Fed’s preferred July personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, with core PCE – which excludes food and energy – up 3.3%. Hammack warned that U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s target for more than five consecutive years; the longer it lingers, the harder it will be to push prices down, and the greater the pain for households and businesses.

Hammack is a voting member of the Fed’s rate‑setting committee this year. At the July meeting she joined two other officials in voting against keeping rates unchanged, advocating a one‑point hike. The Fed at that time kept the federal‑funds target range at 3.5%‑3.75% for the fifth consecutive meeting.

She noted that the current financial environment shows no sign that monetary policy is restrictive. The market is still able to produce trillion‑dollar IPOs, and corporate bond issuance continues to hit record highs, indicating that rates are not noticeably suppressing borrowing or economic growth.

Hammack’s biggest worry is that persistently high inflation could embed an inflationary mindset in the public, altering consumption decisions. In recent talks with workers in Erie, Pennsylvania, many said that even with a steady job and daily work, they struggle to make ends meet and can’t even afford a weekend ice‑cream treat for their kids.

This year’s price pressures stem mainly from the Iran war, tariffs and AI‑related demand. The Fed usually treats such shocks as temporary supply issues, but some officials fear their effects could gradually seep into the broader economy. Markets currently expect the Fed to hold steady at the September and October meetings, with the earliest possible hike not coming until December.

items.title: Google不缺晶片與算力！AI變現無解讓市值蒸發6920億美元
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)過去一年一度被視為人工智慧(AI)熱潮最可能的贏家，股價在截至5月13日的一年間飆升逾150%，不僅創下歷史新高，更躋身標普500指數同期表現最佳的25檔成分股，漲幅遠超其他「美股七雄」。
然而，隨著Google母公司面臨AI人才流失、Gemini新模型延後推出，以及巨額資本支出難以證明回報等疑慮，市場風向迅速逆轉。Alphabet股價已較高點下跌15%，市值蒸發6,920億美元，並成為同期拖累標普500指數第二嚴重的個股。

AI人才接連出走 Gemini開發延誤

Alphabet近期股價跌勢的核心，在於市場開始質疑公司能否守住AI競爭優勢。除了投入巨資興建AI基礎設施，最強大模型Gemini 3.5 Pro也因持續改善程式編寫能力而延後推出；在這個領域，Alphabet已被認為落後Anthropic與OpenAI。
Google兩周前雖推出Gemini 3.7 Flash，卻未更新Gemini 3.5 Pro的上市時間。Janus Henderson分析師Divyaunsh Divatia表示，市場通常會給予擁有領先模型的AI贏家較高估值溢價，但Alphabet過去9至12個月享有的優勢已逐漸消退。
人才流失更令投資人不安。Google數月前有兩名高階員工轉投Anthropic與OpenAI；本月稍早，AI策略關鍵人物Jeff Dean離職創業，並帶走數名知名同事。Google DeepMind執行長Demis Hassabis也卸任，轉任董事長。這些消息導致Alphabet股價8月5日重挫4%，單日市值蒸發1,860億美元。
CFRA科技研究主管Angelo Zino表示，Alphabet確實出現人才外流，而投資人目前最關心的問題正是公司能否將AI轉化為收入。不過，AI人才爭奪並非Google獨有，Meta(META-US)曾以高達2億美元的多年薪酬挖走蘋果(AAPL-US)AI模型團隊主管，OpenAI也已從蘋果延攬逾400名員工。

巨額AI支出引疑慮 TPU仍是重要優勢

Google強調，公司AI產品推進速度正處於歷史高點，Gemini 3.7 Flash已成為成長最快的模型，Gemma下載次數也突破10億次。市場對Alphabet保持樂觀的理由，還包括自研張量處理器(TPU)及其累積的龐大運算能力。
然而，投資人日益要求大型AI開發商證明資料中心投資能帶來回報。Alphabet 8月初透過債券發行籌集250億美元，且提供較優渥的殖利率，進一步加深市場對其資金需求的疑慮。公司7月底公布財報後，股價也因資本支出龐大及自由現金流轉負而走低。
Divatia指出，Alphabet明年資本支出將顯著增加，並可能持續出現負自由現金流。公司已透過股權與債券市場籌資，以支應這場通往通用人工智慧(AGI)的資本競賽，令不少投資人感到不安。
儘管近期回檔，Alphabet過去12個月仍上漲65%，表現優於大盤及其他科技七巨頭。多頭認為，人事更迭也可能帶來新氣象，且Google擁有全球頂尖晶片與最大規模之一的運算資源，仍具備成功條件。不過，投資人接下來將要求管理層更清楚說明，AI究竟何時能轉化為實質營收與獲利成長。

items.title: 網路身分驗證龍頭Okta Q2財報優於預期 股價單日飆漲逾20%
items.title_en: Okta, the Leader in Online Identity Verification, Beats Q2 Expectations; Stock Surges Over 20% in a Day
paras: 2026年08月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國網路身分驗證與資安服務業者Okta(OKTA-US)公布截至2026年7月31日止最新財季財報，獲利、營收與訂單指標全面優於市場預期，激勵股價盤中一度飆漲逾20%。
財報顯示，Okta本季調整後每股盈餘為1.05美元，年增率達15%；營收年增率11%，達8.05億美元，優於分析師預期的每股盈餘0.97美元、營收7.93億美元。反映客戶訂單能見度的關鍵指標「當期剩餘履約義務」（CRPO）年增率14%，達25.85億美元，同樣優於市場預期的25.1億美元。公司並預期下一季（截至10月止）營收將達8.15億美元，優於分析師預期的8.08億美元。
研究機構William Blair分析師指出，Okta本季優於預期的表現，來自核心產品全面性的成長動能、大型客戶合作案增加、通路夥伴業務動能強勁，以及業務團隊生產力提升；他認為，這些數據顯示公司中期有望重返雙位數的成長軌道，而人工智慧（AI）應用有望自2028年起成為公司最大的成長機會之一。
受惠於財報利多，Okta股價在27日盤中一度大漲逾20%，至161美元附近；在本次財報公布前，Okta股價今年以來已累計上漲逾50%。Okta主要業務為監控與管理企業內部具較高權限的帳戶存取，防範駭客鎖定擁有系統管理權限的員工或高階主管發動攻擊。
整體而言，Okta本季財報顯示，在資安類股今年強勢上漲的氛圍下，公司業務動能不僅未見放緩，訂單指標與營收展望更雙雙優於預期，為投資人對資安族群後市表現增添信心。

paras_en: On August 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – U.S. online identity verification and cybersecurity services provider Okta (OKTA-US) released its latest quarterly results for the period ending July 31, 2026, with earnings, revenue and order metrics all beating market expectations, prompting the stock to jump more than 20% intraday.

The report shows Okta posted an adjusted earnings per share of $1.05 this quarter, a 15% year‑over‑year increase, and revenue grew 11% year‑over‑year to $805 million, surpassing analyst forecasts of $0.97 EPS and $793 million revenue. The key visibility metric “Current Remaining Performance Obligation” (CRPO) rose 14% year‑over‑year to $2.585 billion, also beating the market’s $2.51 billion expectation. The company now projects Q3 revenue (through October) of $815 million, above the consensus of $808 million.

William Blair analysts noted that Okta’s out‑performance this quarter stems from broad growth in its core products, an increase in large‑customer deals, strong momentum from channel partners, and higher productivity of the sales team. They believe the data indicate the company could return to double‑digit growth in the mid‑term, and that AI applications may become one of its biggest growth drivers starting in 2028.

Benefiting from the earnings beat, Okta’s share price surged more than 20% on the 27th, reaching around $161. Prior to the earnings release, the stock had already risen over 50% year‑to‑date. Okta’s main business is monitoring and managing high‑privilege accounts within enterprises to prevent hackers from targeting employees or executives with system‑admin rights.

Overall, Okta’s quarterly results show that amid a rally in cybersecurity stocks this year, the company’s business momentum remains strong, with order metrics and revenue outlook both exceeding expectations, bolstering investor confidence in the sector’s future performance.

items.title: 伯靈頓Q2獲利優於預期但營收、同店銷售雙雙不如分析師預期 全年財測小幅上修
items.title_en: Burlington Q2 Profit Beats Expectations but Revenue and Same-Store Sales Miss Forecasts, Full-Year Outlook Slightly Raised
paras: 2026年08月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國折扣百貨零售商伯靈頓Burlington Stores(BURL-US)27日公布2026財年第2季財報，獲利表現優於市場預期，但營收與同店銷售則雙雙不如分析師預期，財報呈現「有喜有憂」的雙面樣貌。
財報顯示，伯靈頓第2季淨利達1.843億美元，每股盈餘2.88美元，較去年同期的9420萬美元、每股盈餘1.47美元大幅成長。若排除關稅退款與破產承接租約相關費用等一次性項目，調整後每股盈餘為2.37美元，優於分析師預期的2.19美元。惟營收年增率11%，達30億美元，略低於分析師預期的30.3億美元；同店銷售年增率2%，同樣不如分析師預期的3%。
公司同步上修2026財年調整後每股盈餘財測至11.77至11.97美元，優於先前財測的11.45至11.80美元；全年營收年增率財測則收斂至10%至11%區間，較先前9%至11%的財測區間略為上修下緣。惟展望下一季，公司預期調整後每股盈餘僅1.60至1.70美元，低於分析師預期的2.04美元，營收年增率預期為9%至11%。
伯靈頓第2季共取得5500萬美元關稅退款，公司計畫將此筆款項全數再投入業務，以因應民眾生活成本上升、提供消費者更優惠的價格。執行長Michael O'Sullivan表示：「我們計畫運用這筆退款，讓優惠方案變得更加划算。」由於公司選擇將退款全數再投資，對全年財測的影響因此為中性。
整體而言，伯靈頓本季財報顯示，儘管毛利與獲利端受惠於關稅退款及成本控管而優於預期，但營收成長力道與同店銷售動能已略見放緩跡象，加上下一季財測不如市場預期，顯示美國折扣零售通路在關稅紅利效應消退後，能否延續營運動能仍有待觀察。

paras_en: On August 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. discount department store retailer Burlington Stores (BURL-US) released its FY2026 Q2 results, showing profit that exceeded market expectations, while both revenue and comparable store sales fell short of analyst forecasts, presenting a mixed picture of “wins and worries.”

The report shows Burlington’s Q2 net income reached $184.3 million, or $2.88 earnings per share, a sharp increase from $94.2 million and $1.47 EPS a year earlier. Excluding one‑time items such as tariff refunds and costs related to taking over bankrupt lease agreements, adjusted EPS was $2.37, beating analysts’ estimate of $2.19. However, revenue grew 11% year‑over‑year to $3.0 billion, slightly below the $3.03 billion consensus, and comparable store sales rose only 2%, also missing the 3% forecast.

The company also raised its FY2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $11.77‑$11.97, up from the prior range of $11.45‑$11.80, and narrowed its full‑year revenue growth forecast to 10%‑11%, a modest upward tweak from the earlier 9%‑11% range. Yet for the next quarter, Burlington expects adjusted EPS of only $1.60‑$1.70, below analysts’ $2.04 estimate, and projects revenue growth of 9%‑11%.

Burlington received a $55 million tariff refund in Q2 and plans to reinvest the entire amount back into the business to offset rising living costs and offer consumers deeper discounts. CEO Michael O’Sullivan said, “We intend to use this refund to make our promotional offers even more attractive.” Because the refund is being fully redeployed, its impact on the full‑year outlook is considered neutral.

Overall, Burlington’s quarter shows that while gross margin and profit benefited from the tariff refund and cost controls, revenue growth and comparable‑store momentum are showing early signs of slowdown, and the weaker next‑quarter guidance suggests that the U.S. discount retail channel’s momentum may falter as the tariff‑related boost fades.

items.title: 美國消費電子零售龍頭百思買Q2營收97.8億美元、同店銷售增4.1% 全年財測上修優於市場預期
items.title_en: Best Buy, U.S. Consumer Electronics Retail Leader, Reports Q2 Revenue of $9.78 Billion and Same-Store Sales Up 4.1%; Raises Full-Year EPS Forecast Above Market Expectations
paras: 2026年08月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國消費電子零售龍頭百思買Best Buy(BBY-US)27日公布截至2026年8月1日止的2026財年第2季財報，營收與同店銷售雙雙優於市場預期，公司同步上修全年每股盈餘財測。
財報顯示，百思買第2季營收達97.8億美元，企業整體同店銷售年增率為4.1%，其中美國本土同店銷售年增率達4.5%，本土線上同店銷售年增率則為5.1%；惟國際業務同店銷售年減1.8%，成為表現相對疲弱的區塊。每股盈餘為1.48美元。分產品類別觀察，主要家電類產品第2季銷售僅微幅成長，行動電話類產品則已連續第6季維持成長動能。
公司表示，受記憶體成本上升等產業普遍現象影響，產品成本持續走高，公司正持續因應相關衝擊。展望全年，百思買將2026財年調整後每股盈餘財測上修至6.70至6.90美元，優於分析師預期的6.62美元，顯示管理層對下半年營運動能持樂觀看法。
此外，百思買近期已展開新一代對話式AI購物與客服助理「Ask Blue」的分階段上線，盼藉由生成式AI技術提升線上與門市的消費者體驗，強化其在美國消費電子零售市場的競爭力，作為因應線上通路競爭與同店銷售動能維持的長期策略布局之一。
整體而言，百思買本季財報顯示美國消費者在3C與家電產品的消費意願仍具韌性，尤其線上通路與行動裝置品類展現較強成長動能，惟國際市場疲弱與上游記憶體成本上升，仍是後續觀察公司獲利率能否維持的重要變數。

paras_en: On August 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. consumer electronics retail leader Best Buy (BBY-US) announced its fiscal 2026 second‑quarter results for the period ending August 1, 2026, with both revenue and same‑store sales beating market expectations, and the company simultaneously raised its full‑year earnings‑per‑share outlook.

The report shows Q2 revenue of $9.78 billion and an overall same‑store sales increase of 4.1% year‑over‑year. Domestic same‑store sales grew 4.5% and domestic online same‑store sales rose 5.1%, while international same‑store sales fell 1.8%, marking the weaker segment. Earnings per share were $1.48. By product category, major appliance sales barely grew, whereas mobile phone sales continued their growth streak for the sixth consecutive quarter.

The company said rising memory‑chip costs and other industry‑wide pressures are pushing product costs higher, and Best Buy is taking steps to mitigate the impact. Looking ahead, Best Buy lifted its adjusted fiscal‑2026 EPS guidance to a range of $6.70‑$6.90, above analysts’ consensus of $6.62, indicating management’s optimism for second‑half momentum.

In addition, Best Buy has begun a phased rollout of its next‑generation conversational AI shopping and customer‑service assistant, “Ask Blue,” aiming to use generative AI to enhance both online and in‑store consumer experiences and strengthen its competitive position in the U.S. consumer‑electronics market as part of a long‑term strategy to counter online competition and sustain same‑store sales momentum.

Overall, the quarter’s results show that U.S. consumers remain resilient in spending on 3C and appliance products, with especially strong growth in online channels and mobile device categories. However, weakness in international markets and rising upstream memory costs remain key variables for future profitability.

items.title: 川普又來了！安大略湖一夕變「美國湖」 加拿大氣炸
items.title_en: Trump Returns! Ontario Lake Overnight Becomes “America Lake”, Canada Fumes
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周四(27日)簽署行政命令，宣布將美加邊境的安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)，並稱新名稱「立即生效」。此舉正值美國與加拿大貿易談判破裂、雙方互祭關稅之際，進一步加劇兩個傳統盟友間的緊張關係。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室簽署命令前表示，「我們將把安大略湖改名為美國湖，立即生效。」白宮官員指出，行政命令要求內政部長伯格姆(Doug Burgum)及內政部更新美國地理名稱資訊系統(GNIS)，並在30天內完成聯邦資料庫及相關文件的名稱變更。
安大略湖是北美五大湖之一，橫跨美加邊境，北側為加拿大安大略省，南側則為美國紐約州。由於湖泊並非完全位於美國境內，加拿大幾乎確定不會承認川普單方面更名。
加拿大工業部長趙美蘭(Melanie Joly)本周稍早在川普首度提出改名構想後便強硬回應：「我們永遠都會叫它安大略湖。就這樣。」加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)辦公室則尚未針對川普簽署行政命令發表回應。
被問及改名是在向加拿大傳遞什麼訊息時，川普起初表示「沒有任何訊息」，隨後卻再度批評加拿大長期在貿易上占美國便宜。他說：「加拿大長期以來一直在貿易上敲我們竹槓」，並稱加拿大「想被當成一個州來對待，但他們不是一個州」。
川普第二任期以來多次以「美國第51州」形容加拿大，引發加拿大方面不滿。此次也是川普第二度針對與鄰國共享的國際水域推動更名。他去年已下令將墨西哥灣(Gulf of Mexico)更名為「美國灣」(Gulf of America)，但新名稱主要適用於美國聯邦政府文件與通訊，並未獲墨西哥等其他國家普遍承認。
川普周四甚至開玩笑表示，美國現在「有一個灣，也有一個湖」，接下來只缺一個海洋，或許可以考慮替大西洋或太平洋改名。
這項改名命令也成為美加貿易戰最新一波交鋒。兩國上周歷經三天密集談判後仍宣告破局，雙方互相指責對方導致協商失敗。美國隨後對價值數十億美元的加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，卡尼政府則宣布反制關稅，預定9月8日生效。
川普進一步揚言，自明年1月起將加拿大汽車及零組件關稅提高一倍至50%。據《彭博》此前報導，川普政府也正在討論其他貿易懲罰措施，以回應加拿大最新反制行動。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Thursday (the 27th) renaming the Canada‑U.S. border lake Ontario to “Lake America,” declaring the new name “effective immediately.” The move comes as trade talks between the United States and Canada have collapsed and both sides have imposed tariffs, further heightening tensions between the two traditional allies.

Before signing the order in the Oval Office, Trump said, “We will rename Lake Ontario to Lake America, effective immediately.” White House officials said the order requires Interior Secretary Doug Burgum and the department to update the U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) and to complete the name change in federal databases and related documents within 30 days.

Lake Ontario is one of North America’s five Great Lakes, straddling the Canada‑U.S. border, with its northern shore in Canada’s Ontario province and its southern shore in New York State. Because the lake is not wholly within U.S. territory, Canada is virtually certain not to recognize Trump’s unilateral renaming.

Canada’s Minister of Industry Melanie Joly responded early this week, after Trump first floated the renaming idea, with a firm “We will always call it Lake Ontario. That’s it.” Prime Minister Mark Carney’s office has not yet issued a response to Trump’s executive order.

When asked what message the renaming was sending to Canada, Trump initially said “there is no message,” but then again criticized Canada for taking advantage of the United States in trade. He said, “Canada has been pulling the strings on trade for a long time,” and claimed Canada “wants to be treated like a state, but it’s not a state.”

Since his second term began, Trump has repeatedly referred to Canada as a “51st state,” sparking Canadian displeasure. This is his second attempt to rename a shared international water body. Last year he ordered the Gulf of Mexico to be renamed “Gulf of America,” a name that applies only to U.S. federal documents and communications and has not been widely accepted by Mexico or other nations.
Trump even joked on Thursday that the United States now “has a gulf and a lake,” and that the only thing missing is an ocean, suggesting perhaps the Atlantic or Pacific could be renamed as well.

The renaming order also marks the latest flashpoint in the U.S.–Canada trade war. After three days of intensive negotiations last week ended in a breakdown, both sides blamed each other for the failure. The United States then imposed a 50% tariff on Canadian goods worth billions of dollars, and the Carney government announced retaliatory tariffs set to take effect on September 8.

Trump further threatened to double tariffs on Canadian automobiles and parts to 50% starting in January next year. Bloomberg previously reported that the Trump administration is also discussing additional trade‑penalty measures in response to Canada’s latest counter‑actions.
